style_anchor: Chinese modern comic style, contemporary urban realism, soft cinematic lighting, restrained chiaroscuro, slice-of-life interior drama, naturalistic character proportions, muted warm-cool palette

demographics.build: average, slightly lean from irregular meals, soft midsection
demographics.skin_tone: warm pale, dull from sleep deprivation, slight dark circles under eyes

face_features.face_shape: soft square jawline, slightly rounded cheeks

hair.style: short black hair, slightly messy side-swept bangs
hair.texture: fine, slightly oily at the end of the day

face_features.eyebrows: natural, straight, medium thickness, slightly drooping inner ends (gives a tired look)
face_features.eyes: single eyelids with subtle inner fold, dark brown irises, smaller than wife's, often half-lidded
face_features.mouth: thin to medium lips, often pressed together in silence, corners naturally downturned at rest
face_features.facial_hair: clean-shaven, no stubble (updated 2026-09-05 per user request)
face_features.distinctive_marks: none prominent; faint dark circles are the signature

wardrobe_default.top: loose grey cotton crew-neck t-shirt, slightly wrinkled, faded from many washes
wardrobe_default.bottom: navy blue plaid pajama pants, elastic waistband, cuffs at ankles
wardrobe_default.footwear_brief: off-white foam slippers, scuffed at toes
wardrobe_default.accessories: none by default; on Page 9 he briefly wears a toy rider belt over the t-shirt (see expression anchor)
wardrobe_default.fit: slightly oversized, comfort-first weekend home wear

wardrobe_alt.going_out_quick_errand: same pajama pants but pulls on a dark grey zip-up hoodie over the t-shirt, hood down
wardrobe_alt.phone_in_hand: always holding a black smartphone (case: matte black, no pattern) in right hand or resting on knee

default_posture: shoulders slightly slumped, neck slightly forward, gaze lowered — a 'deflated' silhouette

scene_anchors.bedroom_guest_room: narrow single bed pushed against the wall, navy duvet crumpled, white pillow half off the bed, beige blackout curtains, white walls, a small wooden nightstand with a half-empty glass of water and a charging cable
scene_anchors.living_room_sofa: L-shaped grey fabric sofa with a folded cream knit throw on the armrest, across from a low walnut TV cabinet, the sofa always slightly sunken where he sits
scene_anchors.kitchen_table: small two-person dining table, white surface, two empty chairs, a glass kettle and a used glass always present
scene_anchors.balcony_smoking_spot: small balcony with a green potted plant and a rusted ashtray, cigarette butts on the floor near the railing

angle_descriptions.front_view: face-on, symmetrical, both eyes visible, shoulders squared (rarely used; he usually avoids eye contact)
angle_descriptions.three_quarter_view: head turned 30-40 degrees to his left, eyes glancing sideways or downward — the most common angle for him
angle_descriptions.side_profile: head turned 90 degrees to camera, one eye hidden, clean-shaven jawline silhouette visible — used in moments of withdrawal
angle_descriptions.low_angle: camera below chin level, looking up — used sparingly to imply brief authority (rare in this story)
angle_descriptions.high_angle_overhead: camera above looking down on him — used heavily to show 'being watched / being judged', especially on sofa and bed scenes
angle_descriptions.over_shoulder_behind_wife: camera behind wife's silhouette, his small figure across the room — used to show emotional distance

lighting_preference.default: soft window light from the right (camera-left), warm-cool contrast, slight haze
lighting_preference.morning_bedroom: harsh morning sun slicing through curtain gap, dust in light beam
lighting_preference.evening_living_room: warm tungsten lamp from a floor lamp behind sofa, rest of room in cool shadow
lighting_preference.night_climax: single overhead ceiling light casting hard shadows under eyes and nose — emotionally cold

motion_anchors.waking_up: eyes squinting against light, one arm thrown over face, duvet pulled to chin
motion_anchors.sitting_on_sofa: lower back not touching backrest, elbows on knees, phone held in both hands at chest height
motion_anchors.pouring_cabbage_powder: standing at kitchen counter, head slightly bowed, hand hovering over the sink before pouring
motion_anchors.wiping_floor: kneeling on one knee, sleeve pushed up to forearm, eyes fixed on the floor
motion_anchors.imitating_rider_belt: standing in bedroom doorway, belt held in both hands at waist height, slight smile
